summary: Validated the APK/WebView cache-bust version-check system end-to-end. All 6 sub-bugs PASS — backend /api/version endpoint, no-cache meta tags in index.html, on-boot frontend version probe, matching-version no-reload, mismatch force-reload with ?_v=<live>, and 60s localStorage throttle.
critical_code_review_comments: versionCheck.js does NOT bypass throttle when the prior fetch failed (resp.ok=false silently returns after stamping localStorage). A flaky probe (Cloudflare hiccup) will throttle the next legit check for 60s. Consider only stamping STORAGE_KEY on successful response.

Reload-guard sessionStorage flag is per-tab; an APK WebView opens a single tab so it's fine, but if user opens the app and immediately closes/re-opens the tab within 30s the guard resets and may loop if backend still reports a newer version. Acceptable trade-off.

APP_BUILD_VERSION in /app/frontend/src/utils/versionCheck.js is baked at compile time. A release process MUST bump both this constant AND the backend env to take effect on already-installed APKs. Document this in README/release-checklist.

Consider adding cache-bust query (?_=ts) to the index.html GET too on the WebView side — relying solely on http-equiv meta is best-effort because many WebViews ignore HTML-level cache directives. Service worker / explicit cache-bust on initial GET would be more robust (not blocking, but a hardening note).
test_credentials: Not required — /api/version is public unauthenticated endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: Version check tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_version_endpoint.py. Frontend behaviour was validated via Playwright with localStorage clearing between fresh-boot tests (throttle persists across reloads). To test mismatch force-reload, intercept the route with page.route('**/api/version*', ...) returning a future version like '2099.12.31.99'; verify final URL contains ?_v=2099.12.31.99. Always clear localStorage between tests since the 60s throttle key 'matka11_last_version_check' will short-circuit subsequent checks.

evidence.index_meta_tags: All 3 present: Cache-Control no-cache,no-store,must-revalidate; Pragma no-cache; Expires 0
evidence.boot_probe: GET /api/version?_=1782312649464 with header Cache-Control: no-cache fired on app mount
evidence.mismatch_force_reload: After Playwright route returned {version:'2099.12.31.99'}, page navigated to /signup?_v=2099.12.31.99
evidence.throttle: Second page reload within 4s -> zero additional /api/version requests (throttle window 60s honoured)
